assets.name: Internal Admin Portal
assets.description: High-interaction fake administrative console miming internal executive single sign-on.
assets.deceptionStrategy: Collects adversary credential stuffing patterns and logs reconnaissance velocity.

assets.name: Finance Database (Payroll 2026)
assets.description: Decoy PostgreSQL schema seeded with synthetic employee compensation entries and honeypot records.
assets.deceptionStrategy: Monitors exfiltration queries (SELECT * INTO OUTFILE) and fires instantaneous critical alerts.

assets.name: Employee Records & PII Archive
assets.description: Synthetic HR ledger with 500 generated anonymized worker profiles and embedded tracking webhooks.
assets.deceptionStrategy: Emits alert upon any file export or batch iteration attempt.

assets.name: Backup Configuration & Cloud Keys
assets.description: Fictional YAML/ENV backup file containing inactive lure AWS tokens and honey-credentials.
assets.deceptionStrategy: Immediate webhook tripping if attacker tests keys against public canary endpoint.

assets.name: Internal API Documentation (Swagger)
assets.description: Decoy OpenAPI spec listing fake microservices with artificial delays to trap crawlers.
assets.deceptionStrategy: Fingerprints automated scraping tools and directory enumeration bots.

assets.name: Customer Records Archive (Historical)
assets.description: Honey-archive pretending to be 2024-2025 enterprise customer contracts with watermark canaries.
assets.deceptionStrategy: Monitors SMB file opens and reads across legacy network shares.

assets.name: Kubernetes Cluster Credentials
assets.description: Honey-kubeconfig file placed in standard dev home directory with non-routable synthetic tokens.
assets.deceptionStrategy: Detects lateral movement across compromised developer workstation jump boxes.

assets.name: Executive M&A Strategic Plan 2026
assets.description: Bait PDF document containing synthetic merger drafts designed to attract targeted espionage.
assets.deceptionStrategy: Fires outbound honeydns lookup upon document rendering in Adobe Acrobat / PDF engines.

scenarios.title: Admin Portal Credential Harvesting
scenarios.description: Simulates an adversary discovering the decoy Admin Portal, probing hidden authentication endpoints, and attempting brute-force credential entry.
scenarios.expectedTTP: T1595 (Active Scanning), T1110 (Brute Force), T1078 (Valid Accounts)

steps.description: Adversary scanner encounters high-interaction decoy port 8089.
Attacker loads fake login screen and probes SSO redirect parameters.
Automated stuffing script submits administrative dictionary combinations.
Adversary enters seeded canary password triggering targeted telemetry broadcast.

scenarios.title: Database Reconnaissance & Exfiltration
scenarios.description: Simulates internal lateral movement targeting the fictional Payroll Database, schema inspection, and batch data export.
scenarios.expectedTTP: T1087 (Account Discovery), T1005 (Data from Local System), T1567 (Exfiltration Over Web Service)

steps.description: Attacker queries information_schema to map fake compensation tables.
Queries SELECT * FROM mock_payroll_2026 LIMIT 5 to inspect executive salaries.
Attacker triggers batch CSV dump command on synthetic table.

scenarios.title: Lateral Movement via Config File Canaries
scenarios.description: Simulates an adversary searching filesystem directories for uncommitted environment variables, secrets, and cloud configuration files.
scenarios.expectedTTP: T1083 (File and Directory Discovery), T1552 (Unsecured Credentials)

steps.description: Attacker copies decoy .env.production.bak with honey AWS keys.
Honey credentials ping SENTRIX canary gateway with source IP.

scenarios.title: Multi-Stage Advanced Deception Trap
scenarios.description: End-to-end multi-vector scenario chaining API exploration, document downloads, database inspection, and admin panel engagement.
scenarios.expectedTTP: Full Cyber Kill Chain (Recon -> Weaponization -> Lateral Movement -> Exfiltration)
